description: This file contains unit tests for the InterestsViewModel class within an Android application, utilizing Robolectric and coroutine testing frameworks. It tests the UI state transitions based on user actions and data loading, ensuring correct behavior of the ViewModel in different scenarios.

classes.name: InterestsViewModelTest
classes.description: Unit tests for the InterestsViewModel, verifying UI state transitions based on data loading, topic following, and unfollowing actions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the InterestsViewModel instance before each test, setting up route and dependencies.

methods.name: uiState_whenInitialized_thenShowLoading
methods.description: Verifies that upon initialization, the UI state is set to Loading.

methods.name: uiState_whenFollowedTopicsAreLoading_thenShowLoading
methods.description: Checks that when followed topics are being loaded, the UI shows the Loading state.

methods.name: uiState_whenFollowingNewTopic_thenShowUpdatedTopics
methods.description: Tests that following a new topic updates the UI state accordingly.

methods.name: uiState_whenUnfollowingTopics_thenShowUpdatedTopics
methods.description: Verifies that unfollowing a topic correctly updates the UI state.
